_format._comment: Vibrant Academy (Kota) id chain, taken from its own app API (vibrantacademykotaapi.akamai.net.in). Ids are opaque strings the platform hands out — keep them exactly as given, as text. No JSON keys, no SQL columns, nothing reformatted.
_format.batch_id: course_id you enrolled/opened — the batch id
_format.batch_name: course name as shown in the app (e.g. 'Nurture JEE 2026')
_format.topic_id: child folder id inside the subject (parent_id = subject_id)
_format.lecture_id: video row id from folder_contentsv3 (material_type VIDEO)
_format.subject: Physics / Chemistry / Mathematics / Biology
_format.duration_sec: length in seconds if the feed gives it
